_help: Add one object per event. Dates are ISO 8601 in Atlanta time, e.g. 2026-11-14T19:00:00-05:00. Past events stay listed under 'Past'. Example: {"name": "Listening party: ...", "start": "2026-11-14T19:00:00-05:00", "end": "2026-11-14T22:00:00-05:00", "description": "...", "performer": "DJ ...", "url": "https://..."}
